# env/.env.local

```dotenv
REDIRECT_HTTP_TO_HTTPS=true
HSTS_MAX_AGE_SECONDS=31536000
HSTS_INCLUDE_SUBDOMAINS=true
HSTS_PRELOAD=true
```

Use this example to explain:

- why redirects happen before normal page handling,
- why HSTS should only be enabled once HTTPS is stable,
- how the existing default security headers complement HSTS.
